Bill.BriefDescription: Revising the industrial insurance self-insurance program.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to revising the industrial insurance selfinsuranceprogram; and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature finds that: (1) It is fundamental to the Washington workers' compensationsystem that claims be adjudicated and resolved in a fair, informal, andcooperative environment that benefits the injured worker, the employer,and the department of labor and industries; (2) With an appropriate auditing program and statutory penaltystructure, more flexibility and authority for self-insured employers toadminister their claims should be granted; and (3) Revisions to the industrial insurance selfinsurance program should be made to grant selfinsured employers more authority toactively participate in workers' compensation claims.
